proposed_widenings.name: extend_spell_target_count
proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary-target clause modifies how many creatures a specific named spell may target when cast through this feature, bounded by proximity to the primary target. No existing v4 atom or grant_spell_access field models this. grant_spell_access.targetRestriction restricts targets; it cannot add them. scale_target_count scales by slot level, not by feature. A new atom or a new field on grant_spell_access is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.

notes: The two grant_spell_access(prepared) atoms encode the always-prepared clause honestly and typecheck cleanly. The secondary-target-within-10-feet rider is omitted — it has no corresponding v4 atom or surface field. The closest analogue would be a new field on grant_spell_access such as additionalTargets: { count: number, maxFeetFromPrimary: number }, or a standalone effect atom that modifies targeting for specific spells. Classified as atom_widening because the gap is a missing v4 effect/modifier concept, not a missing mechanics family or surface type variant.
